MotorFactory creates four objects unconditionally on its observed Create path; AfLensFactory separately creates InMotor and AfLensControl. No single motor choice occurs in MotorFactory Create.

limitations: facade_dispatch.raw.c loses the LDREQ/LDRNE object selection at52ef8a28/2c and misleadingly shows only F+4. ARM and 50 dispatch tests are authoritative; raw C intentionally remains unedited.

C is LensCpuCommunication, not a proven global common-property object. C.u8[5272] bit6 is proven to select these classes, but no vendor bit-name or complete encoding/physical eligibility rule has been recovered.
Response byte6 is copied by CPU, but52f3a754 and its lower transport are not executed in tests. This does not establish electrical lens communication, response validity or physical motor movement.

256 getter checks are full leaf execution; 50 facade checks execute full facade/wrapper/getter with named command stubs. 256 import checks and25 gate checks are fragments, not full reader execution. Constructor/factory alias chain is static, not dynamic startup execution.
Additional candidate stores at5315e078 and531346e4 were seen in the bounded STRB+272 search; they are not exhaustively traced here. The primary import is not asserted to be the only producer.

AF calculation, detailed actuator encoding, power scheduling and hardware driver execution are outside this delivery. Distinct Paf/Caf object names do not establish physical drive type or direct selection by bit6.

Official old smc DA Star16-50 SDM documentation proves a dual-drive mechanical example, not an ID match, switchable menu or safe forced Joint route on this body. KAF3 lenses lacking an AF coupler cannot gain one by software.
